title: Cosmic All-Seeing Eye
description: A surreal cosmic scene dominated by a massive cracked golden eye with a black diamond pupil and ornate golden banner across the top. In the foreground, a man in a black suit stands with his back partially to the viewer, holding two glowing orbs containing a red planet and a purple silhouetted figure, surrounded by colorful tentacles and floating geometric crystals.
prompt: Surreal cosmic painting of a massive cracked golden eye with intricate patterns and a black diamond pupil floating in space, ornate golden banner with symbols across the top, in the foreground a man in a black suit stands facing the eye while holding two glowing orbs one containing a red planet and the other a purple silhouette, colorful tentacles wrapping around the orbs, scattered glowing geometric crystals and planets in the background, mystical and psychedelic atmosphere
